validation: All original fields except target and quality_review are identical in order; terminal targets equal raw. Reviewed 16 prior-piece context examples against current raw: no approved target imports context facts. Context suffixes match.
coverage_limits: 48 contrast pairs plus 16 spelling pairs and 32 independent examples; not 160 independent scenarios. Text-only synthetic review is not audio or native-speaker certification.
method: Terra independently read all 160 pairs in pages of 16, including long-form cases, comparing stock and custom spelling instructions; corrected unambiguous labels and rejected ambiguous program/programme context.
